{{Quote|I can say nothing, I swear. We are conditioned in youth not to reveal the secrets of the Survivors.|Mission Commander to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Han Solo and the Lost Legacy">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mission Commander''' was one of the elite [[Survivors (Dellalt)|Survivors]] entrusted with the guardianship of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot's treasure vaults on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]], in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].

==Biography==
The Mission Commander was a short, grim man whose long, black hair was parted in the middle and showed a white blaze. It was by this blaze that he was recognized by [[Hasti Troujow]] during her [[Mission to Dellalt|mission]] to Dellalt. Like all Survivors, he was [[Hypno-imprinting|hypno-imprinted]] during childhood. He operated as the assistant to the [[Steward (Dellalt)|Steward]] of the treasure vaults. It was he who was sent by the Steward to awaken the [[Guardian Corps]], and act as the Mission Commander on the attack on [[J'uoch's mining camp]].
